# Pilot Review

**Use it when:** something you built has been running long enough to judge.
**It exists to stop:** a graveyard of half-live projects quietly billing somebody forever.

> *The hardest deliverable is the one that says stop. A pilot that did not pay off is
> information, and killing it cheaply is a win you should be able to say out loud.*

**Report the business number, in their units, not yours.** Model metrics answer "is it
behaving?" — the client asked "did it matter?"
